about: OH product specs (Lane D2, 2026-10-02), one record per sku, merged over public/oh/products.json by sku on the page. Read once per product from the lg.com/us product page's server data (pageProps.productData.product, productPriceData.price, productData.allInfo), as an anonymous visitor, on 2026-10-02. title: the page's product title. salePrice: the page's final price. listPrice: the page's MSRP, only when it is above the final price (a struck price). cta: cart for Add to Cart (CART) and Notify Me (NOTIFY: sold here, out of stock that day), retailer for Find a Retailer (RETAIL) and an external seller (EXTERNAL); absent where the page hides its button (HIDE). width, depth, height: inches, the product's own outside dimensions (for TVs without the stand; for ranges the overall width, height with backguard and depth with handle; for laundry, dishwashers and the rest the page's Product (W x H x D)). vesa: for TVs, the VESA mounting pattern, W x H in millimetres. image: the OH image (public/oh/img/index.json's accepted WebP). A field the page did not give is absent, never null, so a merge never erases the feed's value. Prices change daily; these are 2026-10-02's.
